title: edge-bleed-overlap — an image running off the band edge with copy laid over it
idea: One image runs off the trailing edge of the band and is cut by it, while a solid copy panel overlaps its leading side. Two planes, and neither one respects the band's box.
why_new: nothing in the catalog crosses a band boundary or overlaps two elements. full-bleed-split reaches the edge but keeps the halves apart; collage-overlap overlaps images with each other and is gated to photography. This overlaps copy on media and works on any brief with one photograph.
built_from: one full-aligned image plate and one constrained group pulled over it with a negative margin, plus a CSS hook and a stacking order.
risk: the panel hides part of the image, so the crop has to survive being covered — it needs the same subject-safe-zone thinking the cinematic hero uses. The pull must be a fixed reviewed amount and must reset to zero when the band stacks.
